name: Eldad
title: The Prophet in the Camp
summary: Eldad was one of the seventy elders chosen by Moses to bear the burden of the people. He and Medad remained in the camp while the other elders gathered at the tabernacle, but the Spirit of the Lord still came upon them, and they prophesied in the camp. This event became an important example that God's Spirit is not limited to specific places or human structures.

keyEvents.title: The Selection of the Seventy Elders
keyEvents.description: God commanded Moses to choose seventy of Israel's elders to share the burden of leading the people. Eldad was among those chosen.

keyEvents.title: The Spirit Rests on Eldad and Medad in the Camp
keyEvents.description: Although Eldad and Medad did not go out to the tent of meeting, the Spirit of the Lord came upon them, and they prophesied inside the camp.

keyEvents.title: A Young Man Reports to Moses
keyEvents.description: A young man ran to Moses and told him that Eldad and Medad were prophesying in the camp, which caused concern among some.

keyEvents.title: Joshua tries to stop them
keyEvents.description: Joshua, Moses' servant, asked Moses to forbid Eldad and Medad from prophesying because he believed it threatened Moses' authority.

keyEvents.title: Moses' generous response
keyEvents.description: Moses rejected Joshua's concern and expressed the wish that all of the Lord's people were prophets, and that the Lord would put His Spirit on them all.
